# KARADAVI

> Machine trust, perception, and semantic authority infrastructure.

KARADAVI is an experimental research platform exploring how software can understand digital entities, evaluate evidence, model authority, represent uncertainty, and produce machine-readable trust state.

## Core pipeline

Digital World → Perception → Identification → Semantics → Evidence → Authority → Trust → Machine-readable State

## Core principle

Trust should be inspectable. A trust signal should remain connected to the claim, evidence, provenance, authority context, and uncertainty that produced it.

## Public repository

This repository is the public research and architecture surface. It contains conceptual architecture, research models, public specifications, schemas, examples, and experiments.

## Private boundary

Private implementation, deployment topology, private datasets, credentials, internal endpoints, and unreleased product work are intentionally excluded.

## Key documents

- docs/architecture.md — public conceptual architecture
- docs/research-model.md — research model for evidence, provenance, authority, and uncertainty
- docs/public-private-boundary.md — publication boundary
- specs/entity-state.schema.json — experimental entity-state schema
- research/001-trust-is-not-a-score.md — initial trust-model hypothesis
- examples/basic-entity-state.json — basic machine-readable example

## Status

Active research / early specification. Terminology and schemas may change as experiments are conducted.
